piece.headline: AYODELE TAKES THE TOP AS CHERAG LEAVES 24 ON THE BENCH
piece.standfirst: Ayodele takes top spot, and Cherag's bench is the reason it happened. Haaland blanked on the armband for most of the league.
piece.big_picture: Ayodele now sits on 700, Cherag 8 back. Cherag left 24 points on his own bench, which is the whole story. Ayodele sold Ødegaard for Gakpo and lost 8 on the swap, yet still climbed. A lucky escape, but a lead is a lead.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Hishaan ignored the 21 Haaland armbands and picked Barry. It returned 32 against 4. Lonely at first, loud now.
piece.one_to_watch: Title race first: Ayodele leads Cherag by 8. Behind that, Tobi and Dinesh are 4 apart on the Tin Pot line, and Nihal and Nanik 7 apart on the Gold line.
